FN-11IT6ZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 77
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Economic Development
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 01/13/2026
Senate Bill 77 as introduced would provide for the continuance of the Alabama 911 Board until
October 1, 2028, pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The provisions of this bill will not
otherwise affect state or local funding.
